name: ZEBRA (Zero Extrinsic Back Ratio) - Put
summary: Buy 2 deep ITM puts and sell 1 ATM put; a defined-risk short-stock replacement with roughly -100 deltas and near-zero net extrinsic.

legs.strike_rule: ITM strike at put delta -0.70 to -0.75
ATM strike, put delta -0.48 to -0.52 (covered by the 2 longs)

when_to_use: When a bearish view is wanted with about -100 deltas, defined risk, and no theta bleed, and without the borrow/locate problems of actually shorting shares. Especially useful in a paper account where short stock behavior is unrealistic.
max_profit: very large (behaves like 100 short shares down to zero)
breakevens: approximately the ATM strike minus (net debit/100) adjusted for embedded intrinsic
entry_rules: Long strike delta -0.70 to -0.75; short strike delta -0.48 to -0.52.
Net extrinsic check: (2 x long extrinsic) - (1 x short extrinsic) <= $0.15 per share, otherwise reject.
Net delta between -0.90 and -1.05 per unit.
30-60 DTE; both strikes OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.10, 10% of mid).
Single 3-contract multi-leg order at mid, pay up to mid + $0.05.
management_rules: Manage as a directional position: profit target at 50% gain on the debit, stop at 35% loss of the debit.
Roll out at 14 DTE to preserve the zero-theta property.
Re-strike if the long delta exceeds -0.90.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 1 short ATM put, covered by 2 long ITM puts. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short put is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
assignment_risk: The short ATM put carries near-zero extrinsic by design, which invites early assignment on a decline; assignment buys 100 shares at the strike, hedged by 2 long ITM puts. The system must close rather than absorb the delivery. Put assignment is interest-driven rather than dividend-driven, so the trigger is deep moneyness plus low extrinsic.
liquidity_needs: Moderate; deep ITM put strikes are wider - restrict to the most liquid ETFs and mega-caps.
common_mistakes: Skipping the extrinsic check; holding into the last two weeks; forgetting that a winning put ZEBRA drives the short leg ITM and raises assignment risk exactly when the trade is working.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
